measurements.name: the prompt decision
measurements.what: Whether to show the accuracy prompt, and why not.

measurements.name: building an observation
measurements.what: Every question becomes a learning observation. This is the only cost a user can experience.

measurements.name: writing the observation
measurements.what: Persisting the observation before the answer is handed back. The real cost of §12, against the real database.

measurements.name: recording a rating
measurements.what: Constructing the feedback event a user's answer becomes.

measurements.name: labelling an observation
measurements.what: Attaching a rating to the observation it belongs to.

measurements.name: proposing a candidate
measurements.what: Turning a correction into a candidate learning case.

measurements.name: applying a preference
measurements.what: A user changing one of the eight settings.

measurements.name: the raw-feedback guard scan
measurements.what: A static scan of every feedback module. Runs in CI and in -FeedbackCritical. Never on the answer path.
